```xml
<ContentPage xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             xmlns:models="clr-namespace:Gallery.Models"
             xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:Gallery.ViewModels"
             x:Class="Gallery.PhotosPage"
             x:DataType="vm:PhotosViewModel">
    <CollectionView ItemsSource="{Binding Photos}">
        <CollectionView.ItemsLayout>
            <GridItemsLayout Orientation="Vertical"
                             Span="3"
                             HorizontalItemSpacing="8"
                             VerticalItemSpacing="8" />
        </CollectionView.ItemsLayout>
        <CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
            <DataTemplate x:DataType="models:Photo">
                <Border Padding="4" StrokeThickness="0">
                    <VerticalStackLayout Spacing="4">
                        <Image Source="{Binding ImageSource}"
                               Aspect="AspectFill"
                               HeightRequest="120" />
                        <Label Text="{Binding Caption}"
                               HorizontalTextAlignment="Center" />
                    </VerticalStackLayout>
                </Border>
            </DataTemplate>
        </CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
    </CollectionView>
</ContentPage>
```

This is only the requested three-column gallery: it adds no selection, refresh, grouping, or `ViewCell`.
